title: Upper body flex (posing practice)
summary: Short upper-body posing practice clip (double biceps, triceps). The transcript is only background French music; per the description, his posing is poor and he wants to sharpen it before entering YouTube bodybuilding competitions.

claims.claim: He considers his posing skills atrocious and is practising, filming from afar to check angles in the mirror, because he plans to enter YouTube bodybuilding competitions.
